None of the production files (`src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, etc.) were modified. Noticeably, the candidate's own test file even includes `@ts-expect-error history is the feature configuration added by this ticket`, confirming the feature was never implemented and the tests fail immediately.
